bases.filters:
filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("zz-b3")
    - file.ext == "md"
formulas:
  half: n / 2
views:
  - type: table
    name: "string"
    filters: "n > 2"
  - type: table
    name: "or"
    filters: 
      or:
        - s == "apple"
        - n > 50
  - type: table
    name: "not many"
    filters: 
      not:
        - n > 50
        - s == "apple"
  - type: table
    name: "nested"
    filters: 
      and:
        - b == true
        - or:
            - n > 5
            - file.inFolder("zz-b3/sub")
  - type: table
    name: "error rows"
    filters: "n.abs() > 1"
  - type: table
    name: "error all"
    filters: "n.nope()"
  - type: table
    name: "formula filter"
    filters: "formula.half > 1"
  - type: table
    name: "null compare"
    filters: "d < date(\"2026-02-01\")"
  - type: table
    name: "not error"
    filters: 
      not:
        - n.nope()
  - type: table
    name: "empty and"
    filters: 
      and: []
  - type: table
    name: "list contains"
    filters: "l.contains(\"x\")"
  - type: table
    name: "tags filter"
    filters: "file.hasTag(\"one\")"
  - type: table
    name: search
    order: [file.name, s, n, b, d, l, mixed]
bases.search:
filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("zz-b3")
    - file.ext == "md"
formulas:
  nn: empty.nope()
  nn2: n.abs()
views:
  - type: table
    name: search
    order: [file.name, s, n, b, d, l, mixed, formula.nn, formula.nn2]
  - type: table
    name: string
    filters: "n > 2"
  - type: table
    name: string2
    filters: n > 2
bases.summaries:
filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("zz-b3")
    - file.ext == "md"
formulas:
  half: n / 2
summaries:
  Twice: values.length * 2
  Mean: values.mean()
  Bad: values.nope()
  Echo: values
views:
  - type: table
    name: T
    order: [file.name, s, n, b, d, l, mixed, formula.half]
    summaries:
      n: Sum
